items.name: Says what you do, for whom and where
items.evidence: Your headline is your name; what you do and where comes further down.
items.fix: Put what you do and the area you serve in the first line people see on a phone.

items.name: One clear main action at the top
items.evidence: The only way to act sits at the bottom of the page.
items.fix: Pick one action (call, book or get a quote) and make it the main button at the top.

items.name: Headline is more than the business name
items.evidence: Your headline is only the business name.
items.fix: Make the headline the result your customer gets, not just your name.

items.name: Real photo of your work or team
items.evidence: Our review did not reach this item.

items.name: Tap-to-call phone number near the top
items.evidence: We did not find a tap-to-call phone link on your homepage.
items.fix: Make your phone number a tap-to-call link and put it at the top of the page.

items.name: A form or booking link on the homepage
items.evidence: Your homepage has a booking or request link.

items.name: At least two ways to reach you
items.evidence: We found only one way to reach you on the homepage.
items.fix: Offer at least two: a tap-to-call number plus a form, booking link or email.

items.name: A way to reach you on every screen while scrolling
items.evidence: Needs a real browser on a phone.

items.name: One consistent phone number
items.evidence: We found 2 different phone numbers on your homepage.
items.fix: Use one main number everywhere, so nobody calls the wrong line.

items.name: Reviews or testimonials on the site
items.evidence: We did not find reviews or testimonials on your homepage.
items.fix: Show three or four real reviews on the homepage, with names.

items.name: Concrete facts near the top
items.evidence: Good facts, but below the first screen.
items.fix: Put real numbers near the top: years in business, jobs done, warranty.

items.name: Credentials or guarantees easy to find
items.evidence: Your licence and insurance are stated plainly.

items.name: Real people or real jobs shown
items.evidence: Our review did not reach this item.

items.name: Talks about the customer more than itself
items.evidence: Not enough text on the homepage to count.

items.name: Concrete facts outnumber vague phrases
items.evidence: We counted 4 stock phrases like "quality service" or "trusted" and only 3 lines with real numbers.
items.fix: Swap phrases like "quality service" for specifics: numbers, places, results.

items.name: Common worries answered before the main button
items.evidence: Price, timing and what happens next are not answered.
items.fix: Answer price, timing and trust questions before the main button.

items.name: Main menu has 7 items or fewer
items.evidence: Your main menu has 9 items.
items.fix: Cut the main menu to 7 items or fewer.

items.name: One thing stands out at the top
items.evidence: Our review did not reach this item.

items.name: The main action sits where each section ends
items.evidence: Needs a real browser on a phone.

items.name: A next step on the page
items.evidence: Your homepage has a button or link asking people to call, book or get a quote.

items.name: Set up for phone screens
items.evidence: Your homepage tells phones to fit the page to the screen.

items.name: No sideways scrolling on a phone
items.evidence: Needs a real browser on a phone.

items.name: Text readable and buttons tappable on a phone
items.evidence: Google PageSpeed flagged text size or tap targets on a phone.
items.fix: Use larger text and bigger, well spaced buttons on phones.

items.name: Call or book reachable within one thumb scroll
items.evidence: Needs a real browser on a phone.

items.name: Main content appears quickly on a phone
items.evidence: Main content took 4.7 seconds to appear in our phone test. We look for 2.5 or less.
items.fix: Shrink large images and drop scripts the page does not need.

items.name: Page holds still while it loads
items.evidence: The page held still while it loaded in our phone test.

items.name: Page weight under 3 MB
items.evidence: The homepage weighed 3.6 MB. We look for under 3 MB.
items.fix: Compress images and remove files the page does not use.

items.name: A page title that names you and what you do
items.evidence: Your homepage has a page title, 34 characters long.

items.name: A page description
items.evidence: Your homepage has no description for search results.
items.fix: Add a description of about 50 to 165 characters.

items.name: One main heading that says something
items.evidence: Your homepage has one main heading, but it is only one or two words.
items.fix: Use one main heading that says what you do.

items.name: Local business details for Google
items.evidence: We did not find local business structured data on your homepage.
items.fix: Add LocalBusiness structured data with your name, address and phone.

items.name: Name, service and city together in the text
items.evidence: Your service and city appear together.

items.name: Images described with alt text
items.evidence: 1 of 2 images have alt text.
items.fix: Give every image a short description (alt text).

items.name: Secure connection, and http forwards to https
items.evidence: Your homepage loads over https, and the plain http address forwards to it.

items.name: No visible errors or placeholder text
items.evidence: We found no error or placeholder wording on the homepage.

items.name: Footer year is current
items.evidence: Your footer still says 2021.
items.fix: Update the footer year (or let the site set it itself).

items.name: Nothing loads over plain http
items.evidence: Nothing on the homepage loads over plain http.

items.name: An analytics tag
items.evidence: We did not find an analytics tag on your homepage.
items.fix: Add an analytics tag, like Google Analytics.

items.name: A way to measure leads
items.evidence: We did not find a way to measure leads, like call tracking or a thank-you page.
items.fix: Track form sends and calls (a thank-you page, call tracking or an events tag).

top.heading: Phone visitors can't tap to call you
top.body: We did not find a tap-to-call phone link on your homepage.
top.fix: Make your phone number a tap-to-call link and put it at the top of the page.

top.heading: Your homepage shows more than one phone number
top.body: We found 2 different phone numbers on your homepage.
top.fix: Use one main number everywhere, so nobody calls the wrong line.

top.heading: There is no clear first step at the top of the page
top.body: On your homepage: "Call us at (316) 555-0142". The only way to act sits at the bottom of the page.
top.fix: Pick one action (call, book or get a quote) and make it the main button at the top.

working.text: You've been in business since 1998, which builds trust.
You back every roof with a 10-year workmanship warranty.
You show real volume: over 2,400 roofs replaced.
Visitors can send you a request from the homepage.
The page asks visitors to take a next step.

verdict: You've been in business since 1998, which builds trust.
The biggest gap: phone visitors can't tap to call you.

report.rule: How we graded this: 10 areas, 100 points, scored only from what anyone can see on your homepage. Each item is a pass, a partial or a miss. A is 90 or more, B 80 to 89, C 70 to 79, D 60 to 69, F under 60. Items we could not check are left out of the score and named.
report.scoreLabel: The grade is ProyTech's score for these checks on this date. It does not come from Google or any rating body.
